payload.rationale: Standardize normalization mitigates site-specific staining intensity variation (test annotations from a different site), forcing the model to rely on structural and textural cues rather than absolute color values. This is critical given inherently ambiguous label boundaries (background/debris, stroma/smooth muscle, mucus overlap). All three orientation-safe augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90) are applied train-only to expand the effective sample size across 9 moderately imbalanced classes (ratio 1.63), covering the full 2D dihedral group and reducing overfitting risk on the smaller classes (7886, 8006 samples) without introducing orientation-dependent artifacts.
